notes.page_content: Two-column handwritten cancelled algebra calculation involving indexed e and f symbols, a descended Greek letter read primarily as eta, delta, lambda, alpha and beta; left boxed system and expansion, rotated note, right braced system and descending equality calculation.
notes.author_own_uncertainty_comment: No verbal statement of authorial uncertainty is visible. C and this reader’s uncertainty markers are editorial.
notes.title_date_page_counts: One scan, no title or date and no independently identifiable authorial page number; archive pencil 3 appears near the upper-left paper edge. H page 3 corresponds to scan 4 under the brief.
mathematics_led_reading_decisions: The repeated i+1 notation prompted inspection of the lower second-case subscript; the crop preserves i-1|i+1 rather than forcing the neighboring pattern.
The coefficient (1-alpha) was inspected because its joined 1/minus outline initially resembled a plus; the crop shows a horizontal minus attached to the end of the 1. It agrees with both witnesses.
The repeated first-factor i indices prompted inspection of the expansion: f_i is visually secure; e_i remains qualified by the 1 alternative.
The detached stroke above f_2 in the cancelled tail is kept despite the surrounding expansion using plain f symbols. No mathematical repair or proof check was performed.
notes.collation_scope: All twelve C doubt loci have explicit report rows. H editorial notes and orientation captions Encadré/pour and À droite/pour are treated as apparatus, while printed punctuation immediately attached to formula readings is collated. H explicitly acknowledges the descending arrangement in a note, so its linear typesetting alone is not reported as an omission.
notes.diff_flag_usage: diff_C is true for changed C readings or newly introduced/removed doubt qualifications; a retained C doubt has diff_C=false. Rewrapping the same alternatives or substituting uline for math underline is not counted as a change. H=null is never used because H has full text for this page.
notes.visual_method: Whole image viewed once; half a viewed once; half b viewed once. Sixteen local crops made once each and viewed once each, with PIL LANCZOS enlargement and autocontrast; rotated note crop is turned 180 degrees. No OCR, other pages, other readers, external sources, or proof validation used.
notes.unchanged_ink_checks: The full initial pair, every term of the left boxed system, eta=e_(d-1) and delta pair, e2/e3 equations, rotated note, right top range and all four relations, lower range, three vertical equals, beta/alpha conclusions, and both foot equations were read against the halves. Signs, index strokes, punctuation, and local cancellation boundaries were checked visually.
